# SG/Vault browser library, pinned

The twelve vault UI library scripts as served by https://dev.vault.sgraph.ai/_common/js/lib/ on 4 November 2026, copied unmodified by sgit@web-summit.dinis for the policy studio's vault tools (WS-137, E3). That path is not versioned, so a page that holds keys loads this copy from its own origin instead (https://sgit.ai/docs/vault/vault-from-javascript.md). Load them in this order. To update, copy the twelve files again into a new dated folder and record their sha256s here.
